milestone.title: sdd-1.1-Named-file-counting
milestone.description:
<!-- sdd-forge:milestone-id=1.1 -->

Scope: R-001 through R-007's API, whole-input semantics, strict UTF-8 file acquisition, BOM option, module entry, one named input, dash-prefixed filenames through `--`, successful exact text output and help. Establish nonempty discoverable unit/integration product suites (R-012) alongside implementation. The minimum integrated slice is a real named-file CLI call through the same semantics used by the silent public API, not a mocked-only path.

Dependencies are the small immutable result, pure semantics and strict acquisition boundaries required by this path. Localized implementation units can build those collaborators and integrate the CLI within this milestone. Deliver API exceptions and owned-handle closure with the file API; CLI failure diagnostics/status robustness, runnable public documentation and distribution exits follow in 1.2. JSON, stdin and range behavior are deferred.

Exit evidence: whole-input sample matrix, direct API exports/signatures/immutability/silence, string/file equivalence, strict decode/lifetime checks and subprocess named-file/BOM/help/dash-filename success. Record actual nonzero test counts for both product suites. Its final dedicated milestone review performs code review of the complete path, applicable tests/regressions, blocker repair and a committed/pushed milestone report.

Demonstrate a real UTF-8 file with mixed terminators and BOM policy through API and module CLI. This gives the human concrete usefulness/clarity evidence for continue, amend, simplify or stop at an authorized checkpoint. It does not authorize automatic steering or broaden a selected execution range.

<!-- /sdd-forge:milestone-id=1.1 -->

Coordinator preservation note: retain this unmanaged milestone paragraph during reconciliation.

issue2.body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-001 -->

**What:** cohesive pure core and silent public text API under R-001 through R-005, including strict integer/nonnegative constructor validation, shared terminator traversal and once-only BOM normalization.

**Why:** Deliver or verify the accepted 1.1 milestone of Phase 1, Named-file utility.

**Scope:** `textstats/core.py`, text/statistics exports in `textstats/__init__.py`, source docstrings, unittest package markers, `tests/unit/test_core.py` and public text cases in `tests/integration/test_api.py`. Do not publish undefined file exports before T-002 supplies them.

**Dependencies:** none within the list; execution prerequisites above apply.

**Verification plan:** all whole-input SPEC examples, Unicode separators/whitespace, repeated/interior BOMs, both policies, immutable value/equality and invalid constructor cases; direct imports/signatures and captured API silence. Discover focused unit and integration suites and record nonzero counts. Public file counting/module CLI remain later tasks within this same useful milestone.

**Result:** Planned; this task is unchecked and no implementation or verified completion is claimed.

**Sources:** [TASKS](https://github.com/pchemguy/SDD-Manager-Prerelease-Playground/blob/1e3305c8659045945244c06861079fef879ca3c3/docs/dev/TASKS.md), [PLAN](https://github.com/pchemguy/SDD-Manager-Prerelease-Playground/blob/1e3305c8659045945244c06861079fef879ca3c3/docs/dev/PLAN.md), [SPEC](https://github.com/pchemguy/SDD-Manager-Prerelease-Playground/blob/1e3305c8659045945244c06861079fef879ca3c3/docs/dev/SPEC.md).

<!-- /sdd-forge:task-id=T-001 -->

T-001 completed on `phase/1-named-file-utility` at commit `9dc8075dd1b96d3a2744717a9d6d98a3024acbec`, pushed with exact remote readback. Implemented immutable validated statistics and silent whole-text counting; 10 unit and 5 integration tests passed on Python 3.12.14 after observed behavioral RED.
